newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE'S ERGO MUTUAL FUNDS TO LAUNCH BALANCED FUND.
newsitem.headline: GREECE'S ERGO MUTUAL FUNDS TO LAUNCH BALANCED FUND.

text.p: Ergobank's mutual fund management subsidiary has filed with the capital market commission for approval to launch a new balanced mutual fund, it said on Monday.
The fund management company said its assets under management reached 480 billion drachmas in May 31, up 9.7 percent from April.
Ergo's equity growth fund had a year-to-May 31 return of 65.3 percent and was 94.2 percent invested in equities.
Its fixed income fund returned 5.4 percent from the beginning of the year. Its asset allocation was 90.9 percent bonds, 6.8 percent cash and 2.2 percent domestic equities.
Ergo's money market fund with assets of 394 billion drachmas returned 4.6 percent. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
